sql_templates.description: Fetch FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index data for last 20 sessions.
sql_templates.name: flow_regime_breadth_index_analysis
sql_templates.statement:
WITH latest_flows AS (
    SELECT trade_date, fii_net_today, dii_net_today,
           fi_trend, di_trend
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
),
latest_regime AS (
    SELECT trade_date, regime, confidence
    FROM signals.regime_history
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
),
latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT trade_date, adv_volume, dec_volume, ad_signal
    FROM breadth.market_daily
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
),
latest_index AS (
    SELECT trade_date, close, change_pct, trend_signal
    FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE index_symbol = 'Nifty 50' AND trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
)
SELECT f.trade_date, f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today,
       r.regime, r.confidence,
       b.adv_volume, b.dec_volume, b.ad_signal,
       i.close, i.change_pct, i.trend_signal
FROM latest_flows f
JOIN latest_regime r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN latest_breadth b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN latest_index i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
ORDER BY f.trade_date DESC;

synthesis_guidance: ['Create a matrix comparing each factor (flows, regime, breadth, index) over 20 sessions.', 'Highlight any persistent trends indicating risk-on or risk-off contexts.']
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 1940
